_doc: Policy for tests/lib/check-skill-refs.py — the guarantee that every skill,
agent or blueprint named anywhere in this repo resolves to one that ships.
The checker derives its inventory from disk, never from a list here, so
adding a skill needs no edit to this file and deleting one immediately turns
every surviving reference into a failure.
`known_external_refs` is the only allowlist, and it is deliberately small:
each entry names something that is referenced by design but does not ship
from this repo. A generic hyphenated word never needs an entry — the checker
only inspects *marked* references (a backticked identifier next to the word
skill/agent/blueprint, or following call/invoke/delegate-to), so ordinary
prose like `breaking-change` or `edge-case` is invisible to it.
`legacy_commands` records the slash commands that are decoupled from
directory names on purpose. The checker asserts every `/ns:verb` occurrence
is a key here and every value resolves to a live skill, which turns an
undocumented decoupling into a declared, verified one.
`banned_names` is a completeness gate for a rename in flight: it matches
bare substrings repo-wide (not just marked references), so a retired name
cannot survive in a sentence the main mode would happily ignore.
`frozen_literals` records identifiers a rename must NOT touch. The checker
asserts none of them ever appears in `banned_names`, so a later sweep cannot
'helpfully' rename a gate id or a user-disk path.

The checker exempts its own source, for the same reason check-neutrality.py does: it has to spell out the reference shapes in order to match them, and its self-test fixtures name components that do not ship. Fixtures use obviously-synthetic names so they cannot quietly go stale either.

known_external_refs.superpowers:brainstorming: third-party plugin skill (obra/superpowers); a hard prerequisite, not shipped here
known_external_refs.spec-reviewer: optional host-provided delegate for the spec/plan gates; deliberately external (references/decision-heuristics.md:105)
known_external_refs.report-builder: V2 roadmap item, explicitly not implemented (references/architecture.md:194)
known_external_refs.general-purpose: host-provided subagent type, not a shipped agent
known_external_refs.playwright-cli: optional host-provided skill for Playwright runs (qa-e2e-generator/SKILL.md:262)

frozen_literals.verification-evidence.json: names the artifact, not the skill that writes it
frozen_literals.spec.approved: gate id — frozen by commit b8374ae
frozen_literals.plan.approved: gate id — frozen by commit b8374ae
frozen_literals.feature.verification: gate id — a phase noun, not a directory name
frozen_literals.qa.drift: gate id — frozen by commit b8374ae
frozen_literals..agentic/guides/: path that lands in users' repositories
frozen_literals..agents/memory/: path that lands in users' repositories
